basic_info.description:
This home is a new condo with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, 1 space garage parking, corner unit. Conveniently located in San Francisco near parks, dining and walkways near the water. It features an open floor plan, tall ceilings, natural light. This home is ready to move-in.

Utilities: Resident is responsible for all utilities. Minimum credit score of 640 required. Minimum monthly income requirement 2.2 (net) times more than the monthly rent. Renters Insurance is required with Creekside Real Estate listed as "additional interest". Rental Insurance does not include earthquake coverage. This is a no smoking residence. No Marijuana/Cannabis as well. As property owner or manager, we do not discriminate in the rental or property on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, familial status, or national origin.
Creekside Real Estate trusts that all material in advertisement to be correct and assume no legal responsibility for the accuracy. All information subject to change or withdrawal without further notice.
